objective: Preregister 18 candidates for T-20260928-44 to answer the coverage-map gap `relative_value.pairs_stat_arb`'s long-only cell: is a long-only binary relative-strength switch between two highly correlated ETFs (hold whichever leg has stronger trailing momentum, hold SHY if both are weaker than SHY) worth keeping under the frozen K1/K2 contract, and does the switching mechanism itself add value over a static 50/50 blend of the same two legs? 12 PAIR_* candidates (6 pairs x lookback {63,126}, monthly rebalance, rotation_cell's own top_n=1/menu-size-2 mechanism, unedited) plus 6 STATIC5050_* placebo controls (fixed 50/50 blend, no ranking, no cash filter). Resolves `dir:etf_pair_relative_strength_switch`.
target_regime_and_horizon: Same frozen windows as S1-S3 and every prior batch-screening round: stress 2016-05-02..2023-09-15 and anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17, judged on date-neutral Sharpe (median over monthly rebalance-day offsets 0-20 trading days). The 2026-01-02..2026-09-17 holdout is reference-only and contaminated. All 11 tickers needed (QQQ, SPY, SMH, XLE, XOP, KRE, XLF, IWM, ARKK, SHY, BIL) are confirmed present in the local SIP daily panel from 2016-01-04 through 2026-09-28 (verified this session via a direct DuckDB query against data/sip/daily/*/*.parquet), so both windows have full coverage -- no short-sample caveat applies to this batch, unlike T-43's political ETFs.
existing_solution_comparison: This batch reuses `rotation_cell`'s already-live mechanism unedited (imported from run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.py, not reimplemented) at menu size 2 / top_n=1, the same engine T-40 and every other batch-screening round in this repo already use; it introduces no new signal or weighting rule, only a new (2-ticker) menu shape per candidate and a new placebo family (fixed 50/50 blend) not used by T-40. `grep -ril "pair_switch|relative.strength" reports/research/iterations reports/research/ledger` found no prior local test of any of these six specific pairs through this engine (hits were background mentions: cross-asset/defense-first sleeve notes, factor-batch source HTML, dip-reversion source HTML, and unrelated hypothesis cards). `oc research directions check "pair relative strength switch"` returned `dir:etf_pair_relative_strength_switch` itself (likely_repeat 1.00 -- this is the target direction this round resolves, added by the 2026-09-28 22:21 UTC gap-search round, not a prior *test*) plus three genuinely different prior experiments: H-20260918-06 (pooled ETF relative strength with **no curated menu** -- refuted, a different mechanism: pooling the whole fund universe rather than a hand-picked correlated pair), `dir:pooled_etf_relative_strength_no_menu` (same distinction, refuted for the opposite reason: removing the menu degenerates into either a T-bill pick or a leveraged-product pick), and `dir:collective2_etf_timer_17yr_live` (a proprietary, non-copyable third-party style label, not_executable). None of these three tested a curated 2-ticker correlated-pair switch, so this batch is not a repeat.
remaining_evidence_gap: Whether any of the 12 lookback/pair combinations clears K1 or K2 against S3's frozen reference numbers when run through the batch-screening lane, and separately -- the new question this batch's placebo design adds -- whether any K1/K2 pass survives the counter-evidence check against its own paired STATIC5050 control (i.e. whether *switching* has any value over simply holding both legs). Neither has been tested locally; this round computes both in one pass.
negative_experiments_checked: H-20260918-06 (pooled ETF relative strength, no curated menu -- refuted) and dir:pooled_etf_relative_strength_no_menu (refuted for the opposite degeneration: T-bill pick or leveraged-product pick) both removed the curated-menu structure this batch relies on, so their refutation does not transfer -- this batch keeps a hand-picked, highly correlated 2-ticker menu per candidate, the structural element H-20260918-06 removed. dir:collective2_etf_timer_17yr_live (not_executable, proprietary style label) is unrelated. Robot Wealth's dual-momentum review (fetched this session) documents the standard whipsaw/recovery-lag failure mode for this mechanism family in choppy and V-shaped-recovery regimes -- both are present in the 2016-2023 stress window -- which motivated adding the STATIC5050 placebo family to this batch's own design rather than assuming switching adds value.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: 10bp per side primary, 20bp per side stress, signal at the session close, fill at the next session's open -- identical to the frozen S1/S2/S3 convention and every prior batch-screening round (cost-contract.json). The STATIC5050 controls use the identical cost model (monthly rebalance turnover is charged the same way); no cost assumption was loosened or tightened for either family to make any result more likely to pass.
stop_condition: If none of the 12 PAIR candidates clears K1 or K2 (or reaches watch_recent), `dir:etf_pair_relative_strength_switch` is refuted for this scope and the coverage map's `relative_value.pairs_stat_arb` gap is updated to record that the long-only leg has now been tested and found wanting (separately from the still-untested short leg / cointegration-residual modeling, which needs owner permission for shorting). If a PAIR candidate clears K1 or K2 but fails the STATIC5050 counter-evidence check in every window it passed on, it is downgraded to 'not kept (no switching increment)' and reported as such rather than as a keep. The next round should not re-tune this same 6-pair x {63,126} grid without a new, distinct signal (e.g. a volatility- or correlation-adaptive switch threshold, or a genuinely different pair family) per this dossier's own framing.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Run all 18 candidates through the batch-screening lane (scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260928_44_etf_pair_switch --iteration h20260928_44_etf_pair_switch) against S3's frozen stress/anchor windows, check K1/K2 directly, and check every PAIR pass against its own paired STATIC5050 control; the engine and cost/fill convention are already frozen and reused unedited (menu size 2, top_n=1, a special case already exercised by the same rotation_cell code path T-40 used), so this is the cheapest possible resolution.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one of the 12 PAIR candidates clears K1 or K2 in both required windows and also beats its paired STATIC5050 control's judged Sharpe in every window it passed on.
